mainEntity.name: What travel insurance plan do you need for a golf trip?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel insurance plans help cover your travel investment when traveling to participate in sportsman activities. A golf trip often has additional costs like course fees, concierge services, equipment rentals or additional baggage fees that you may want to have coverage for.

A travel insurance plan that has coverage for your non-refundable sportsman costs is a smart move along with a plan that includes higher baggage coverage, since you’re likely traveling with expensive gear and equipment. Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans can help protect your travel investment, so you have the coverage you need.

mainEntity.name: What does a travel insurance plan cover for a golf trip?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your golf trip.   Look for a plan  that has the coverage and benefit limits you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Adventure sports bundle – if you’re planning extreme activities (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

- Travel inconvenience benefit – a one-time payment for certain inconveniences you encounter on your trip

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available day or night to assist with unexpected travel issues

- Baggage coverage

- Trip cancellation coverage

- Cancel for Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my golf trip?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers a few options for travel insurance plans to help ensure you have the coverage you need while on your golf trip. Our Deluxe plan has the highest benefit limits on baggage coverage, which may be the best option depending on what you’re bringing with you. You may also consider concierge service assistance to help with course planning, tee times and more. All our plans include comprehensive coverage – flights and hotel, non-refundable excursions and rental cars can be covered with your Travel Guard travel insurance plan.

No matter which Travel Guard insurance plan you choose, you’ll have access to our specially trained representatives for 24/7 emergency travel assistance .

mainEntity.name: Can I get coverage for my golf cart?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, unfortunately even with a Rental Vehicle Damage Coverage add-on, golf carts are considered an off-road vehicle meaning they are excluded from coverage.

mainEntity.name: Are there per item limits on baggage coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, it’s important to know that on the Essential and Preferred Travel Guard plans there is a limit of $500 for the first item and $250 for each subsequent item. On the Deluxe plan the limit is $1,000 for the first item and $500 for each subsequent item. Take this into consideration when choosing a travel insurance plan for your golf trip.

Always be sure to read your policy details to make sure you have the coverage you need.
